name: io.github.reidgoodbar/squire
title: Squire
description: CLI-first remote runtimes for validation and offload tasks, exposed over MCP stdio.

environmentVariables.name: SQUIRE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required Squire session or headless token used by the MCP wrapper to authenticate to https://api.squire.run.

environmentVariables.name: SQUIRE_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional API base URL override. Defaults to https://api.squire.run.
